descriptionMarkdown:
Work Requirements Result
Damage Control Action; DC 13 Technology Clear one jam, stall or fire; no HP or parts.
Field repair 10 minutes, tools, one repair kit; DC 13 
Technology
Restore 2d6 + Intelligence HP (minimum 1), OR clear one 
persistent breakdown. One attempt per vehicle between long 
rests. Failure spends the kit. Cannot repair a wreck.
Workshop repair One hour, workshop, one kit or 
equivalent parts
Restore one quarter maximum HP, rounded up, and clear 
one breakdown. Repeat with more time and parts; no check 
for routine work.
Rebuild a wreck Eight hours, workshop, major 
replacement parts; DC 15 Technology
Restore one quarter maximum HP and clear all breakdowns. 
One attempt per day. Failure spends time but does not 
destroy the parts.
Repair kits are Scarce; each supplies one repair. Major parts use the vehicle’s Availability. Alien systems require 
compatible parts and expertise. One helper may provide Help on a repair check. Do not also apply Chapter 18’s item-
condition penalties to the same vehicle damage.
Fuel, power and ordinary ammunition suffice for the agreed mission unless the GM states limits before departure. 
Requisition supplies through Chapter 18. Personal Ammo Packs do not refill vehicle magazines unless compatible. 
Battle cannon shells are always tracked: eight per supplied vehicle, including a loaded shell.
Vehicle Access and Upgrades
